attributes.composition: Cu-rich, Cu 84.01 at.%, other elements small amounts

evidence.section: Initial microstructure analysis of as-cast and cold-deformed HEA
evidence.quote: The Cu content int the Cu-rich phase was 84.01 %, so only small amounts of other elements were present in this phase. The test results were consistent with previous reports [32,33], CoCrCu1.2FeNi HEA had double-sided face-centered cubic structure (labeled as FCC1 and FCC2 respectively). FCC2 phase was the matrix phase of DR structure, and FCC1 phase was the ID structure.

attributes.composition: Cu-lean, Cu 9.7 at.%, Co, Cr, Fe, Ni approximately equal

evidence.section: Initial microstructure analysis of as-cast and cold-deformed HEA
evidence.quote: The Cu content in the Cu-lean phase was 9.7 %, and the atomic ratios of Co, Cr, Fe and Ni elements were approximately the same. The Cu content int the Cu-rich phase was 84.01 %, so only small amounts of other elements were present in this phase. The test results were consistent with previous reports [32,33], CoCrCu1.2FeNi HEA had double-sided face-centered cubic structure (labeled as FCC1 and FCC2 respectively). FCC2 phase was the matrix phase of DR structure, and FCC1 phase was the ID structure.

evidence.section: Initial microstructure analysis of as-cast and cold-deformed HEA
evidence.quote: After deformation, the content of Cu in FCC1 phase was 83.3 %, while the content of the other four elements was very small. In FCC2, the content of Cu was only 10.87 %, indicating that the segregation of Cu was still serious.
